component.name: nefuOS
component.description: Dual-backend hobby operating system (Win32 host exe + x86_64 bare-metal ISO kernel)

components.name: lvgl
components.description: Embedded GUI library; vendored at third_party/lvgl_src/lvgl-9.2.0, configured via third_party/lvgl_conf/lv_conf.h. No source changes; memory pool hooked to nefu_lvgl_pool_alloc.

components.name: stb_truetype
components.description: Single-header TrueType rasterizer used by core/gui/ttfont.cpp; math/malloc hooks added for the bare-metal kernel.

components.name: Montserrat-Medium
components.description: Embedded vector font, converted to a C header at build time (third_party/mont_data.h). Replaced the previously truncated VT323-Regular.ttf embedding.
